title: Recurring dream of a Road in the desert
content: When I was 7 I had this as a reoccurring dream but in my dream people were around watching the road was at a straight up and down on the cliff and other cars were driving fine on the road except this red truck it slammed repeatedly over and over into this wall trying to drive up it till eventually it stopped and when I walked over and looked there were 2 people in side (they were no longer ok )
